key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle-speed and spray-distance selection to achieve desired surface properties and maximize coating hydrophobicity.
method: Evaluate coating roughness, thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive relationships and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships between nozzle traverse speed and roughness/thickness, and parabolic relationships between spray distance and roughness/contact angle.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical optima, parameter ranges, or prediction errors, limiting direct transfer to production.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
